## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run check:safety` passes
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has tests
- [ ] No client data: no real container or account ids, client names, container exports, `.gtm/` folders or tokens (use GTM-XXXXXXX and example.com)
- [ ] Docs and CHANGELOG updated if users will notice the change
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` ...)
